appraisal_events.evidence: "je crus faire preuve de pénétration et de force en lui disant quelques paroles ironiques et blessantes destinées à neutraliser le plaisir qu'elle semblait trouver à être photographiée", and "je réussis du moins à faire disparaître de son visage cette expression joyeuse qui aurait dû me rendre heureux" — a joy taken for "la manifestation exaspérante d'un travers mesquin plutôt que comme la forme précieuse du bonheur".
appraisal_events.explanation: The young man treats his grandmother's happiness as petty vanity and deliberately kills it; the narrating voice reverses that verdict in the same breath, so the diminishment lands on the evaluator as much as on its target.

appraisal_events.evidence: That week his grandmother "avait paru me fuir": she is out when he comes home, "elle s'enfermait avec Françoise pour de longs conciliabules qu'il ne m'était pas permis de troubler", and at night the little knocks on the partition never come — "je restais encore, le cœur palpitant comme dans mon enfance, à écouter le mur qui restait muet et je m'endormais dans les larmes".
appraisal_events.explanation: The one intimacy he counts on is closed to him: he is kept outside her door and her conferences, and reduced to a child listening at a silent wall.

status_effects.explanation: She offers to give up the sitting rather than annoy him and then has her visible joy deliberately extinguished; she yields, he wounds.
The narration's verdict on him is unsparing: what he took for penetration and strength was gratuitous cruelty to someone he loves.
In the same days he is the one who needs and waits: her new indifference deprives him of the joy he had counted on and leaves him in tears.
A real threshold closes on him — the shut door of the conciliabules he may not disturb, and the goodnight summons through the partition that no longer comes.

ambiguities: The grandmother's withdrawal is given no cause in the passage, so it is unclear whether her 'indifférence si nouvelle' is a withholding at all rather than something she is concealing; that uncertainty bears directly on how E2's movement should be read.
